methodologyNotes: Covers remote and GPS e-collar systems used for dog obedience/field training, sold at a published US price directly by the manufacturer. Excludes pure GPS-only trackers with no stimulation/tone/vibration correction capability, bark-only collars, and buried-wire invisible-fence systems. priceUsd is the manufacturer's US list/MSRP price for the base single-dog (or smallest) kit configuration; promotional or sale pricing seen at time of access is called out in priceNote rather than used as priceUsd. specs.range_ft is the manufacturer's stated maximum functional range, converted to feet (GPS-capable systems may state a much larger figure reflecting satellite/cellular tracking range rather than direct RF remote range — noted in provenance). specs.stimulation_levels is the integer count of adjustable static/stimulation levels the manufacturer publishes; null if the manufacturer does not give a specific count. specs.waterproof_rating is the manufacturer's stated rating as free text — a formal code (IPX/ATM) when published, otherwise a plain-language waterproof claim. specs.battery_life_hr is the manufacturer's stated runtime in hours for the dog-worn receiver/collar unit specifically (not the handheld remote/transmitter) per charge; null if not published for the collar. specs.dogs_supported is the maximum number of dogs the base system can train/track simultaneously per the manufacturer, including via same-brand Add-A-Dog or additional-receiver accessories. specs.modes is a semicolon-separated list of correction/feedback types the manufacturer lists (e.g. tone, vibration, static/nick/continuous, LED). specs.gps_tracking is true only if the device includes live location tracking, not merely remote stimulation. specs.collar_size_in is the manufacturer's stated neck-size fit range in inches written 'min-max'; null if not published. Several 2026 seed products from the original brief are discontinued or renamed in-market; each such case is documented in that product's provenance field with the verified current replacement used instead.

products.name: Garmin Sport PRO
products.priceNote: US price $299.99 as listed verbatim on the Garmin manufacturer product page for the Sport PRO handheld + dog device bundle.
products.provenance: Seed name verified unchanged. The Garmin manufacturer page (SKU 010-01205-00) confirms Sport PRO is a radio-frequency handheld remote trainer with no GPS, at $299.99, with 10 stimulation levels (continuous/momentary), a 3/4-mile range, IPX7 (handheld) / 1 ATM (dog device) waterproofing, up to 80h handheld / 60h dog-device battery life, and support for up to 3 dogs with additional collars sold separately. No manufacturer-stated neck-size range was found on the page (only the 3/4-inch strap material is given), so collar_size_in is left null.
